description:
Looking to join a world-class blockchain development team? Ava Labs makes it simple to deploy high-performance solutions for Web3, led by innovations on Avalanche. The company was founded by Cornell computer scientists, who partnered with Wall Street veterans and early Web3 leaders to execute a promising vision for redefining the way people build permissionless networks. Ava Labs is redefining the way people create value with Web3. Join us as we empower people to easily and freely digitize all the world’s assets on one open, programmable blockchain platform.

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Fortary, our institutional digital asset custody platform. In this frontend-leaning role, you will deliver product capabilities end-to-end, from data modeling and API design on our TypeScript backend to the web experience institutions rely on to manage, approve, and stake digital assets across multiple blockchains. You will help shape a platform where security, correctness, and clarity are fundamental to the client experience.

Must be able to work US Eastern Time Zone hours or based in a location that allows consistent availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Deliver Features End-to-End: Lead features from data model and API design through to a refined, responsive user interface, including transaction and approval workflows, staking, portfolio and reporting views, and administrative tooling.

  • Shape the Web Experience: Build and evolve our React web application, partnering with Design to translate complex institutional workflows into interfaces that are clear, intuitive, and trustworthy.

  • Build Robust APIs: Design and implement backend services and integrations with custody infrastructure, blockchain data providers, and third-party platforms, keeping a well-defined, typed contract between frontend and backend.

  • Engineer for Humans and Agents: Keep our codebases clear, well-structured, and easy for both engineers and AI agents to navigate. Record architectural decisions in ADRs, and maintain the agent instructions and reusable skills that encode how we build, test, and ship.

  • Champion Security and Correctness: Treat authorization, approval policies, transaction transparency, and precise financial data handling as core product requirements, working closely with Security and Compliance to uphold SOC 2 controls and support regulatory readiness.

  • Drive Product Advancements: Assess client needs, recommend solutions, and collaborate with Product to incorporate client feedback, shape the roadmap, and recommend technical solutions to client needs.

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Product, Design, and engineers across our signing, mobile, and infrastructure teams.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

  • Frontend Depth, Backend Fluency: Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, complemented by hands-on experience building and operating production backend systems.

  • Product and Design Sensibility: A strong eye for design and a user-centric approach, with the judgment to make sound UX decisions and carry ideas from early concepts to polished implementation.

  • Ownership: A self-directed mindset and full accountability for delivering high-quality, secure solutions.

  • AI-Native Engineering: You use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work, moving faster without lowering the bar, and you review AI-generated code with the same rigor and ownership as your own.

  • Adaptability: Comfort in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as our clients and goals grow.

  • Strong Communication: The ability to lead both deeply technical and high-level discussions, advocate clearly for the best approach, and remain open to feedback.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, primarily frontend, with substantial production backend experience.

  • Expert-level TypeScript and strong React fundamentals.

  • Experience with the TanStack ecosystem (Query, Router, Form, Table), Tailwind CSS, and Zod or comparable libraries.

  • Experience building complex, data-heavy web applications, such as large tables, multi-step forms, and approval workflows, with attention to performance, accessibility, and consistency with a design system.

  • Production Node.js experience, including REST API design, PostgreSQL, and an ORM such as Drizzle.

  • A disciplined approach to testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels (e.g., Vitest, Playwright).

  • A security-first mindset, including authentication and authorization (JWT, RBAC), rigorous input validation, and building auditability and observability into the product.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with Fastify, Redis, Temporal (or a similar workflow engine), and OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience with OpenAPI-driven development and generated API clients.

  • Background in the Web3, DeFi, or digital asset industry, particularly across multiple chains (EVM, Bitcoin, Solana).

  • Familiarity with custody and wallet UX, such as enterprise approval workflows, staking, and hardware wallet signing.

  • Experience with React Native and Expo.

  • Exposure to infrastructure and delivery tooling, including Docker, GitHub Actions, and Kubernetes.

WHY AVA LABS?

Ava Labs builds Avalanche, the blockchain platform institutions use to bring finance onchain. Since Avalanche launched in 2020, we have helped exchanges, banks, asset managers and fintechs move from experiments to live products, from tokenized funds and private credit to stablecoin payments and, now, the clearing and settlement ledger for the NYSE’s upcoming tokenized securities platform. Avalanche lets institutions run their own purpose-built networks with the performance, costs and participation controls they need, while staying connected to a broad ecosystem of DeFi protocols, liquidity and developers.

We are a team of experts in engineering, finance, economics, product and law, headquartered in New York City. You will work alongside people who have built at leading banks, exchanges and crypto companies, with the scope to shape how capital markets move onchain over the next decade. Ava Labs is backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Polychain Capital and Initialized Capital.

Ava Labs is committed to diversity in the workplace and we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not hire on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
